installCommand: git clone --depth 1 -b 3.24.5 https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git .flutter && .flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics && .flutter/bin/flutter pub get
buildCommand: .flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --base-href /app/ --no-web-resources-cdn && rm -rf public && mkdir public && cp -R site/. public/ && cp -R build/web public/app
